This small plot of mine is only a quarter hectare, and I grow it together with bananas and beans like my mother did. Kagera soils here still hold some life from the banana leaves and kitchen waste I throw down, so I do not buy fertilizer from the shop — one bag costs too much for such a small piece, and I would rather spend that money on the children's school. I keep my own seed from last season because it grew well, and the rains here come twice so I do not need to water by hand. My daughter helps me weed when she is home from school, but mostly it is my own two hands on this plot.
